entries.finding: Seeing quadruple: Hubble; the page lists no filters; 498 × 498 px over 24.6 arcsec, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.04937 arcsec per pixel, north 124.3° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 340.125539°, 3.3592354°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
